The Code Nobody Reads

Line-by-line review is going away.

Two years ago I wrote an essay about reviewing generated code, and I would give that advice very differently today.

unique-substack-body Every change still needs a person who owns the decision to ship it. A careful human read of every line is no longer the only way to provide that review.

The craft did not disappear. It moved to the parts that decide whether the code deserves to be trusted.
